# google_oracle_database_database_connection

A DatabaseConnection represents a connection to an Oracle database, specifying
credentials, connection string, and optional network and wallet configuration.


To get more information about DatabaseConnection, see:
* How-to Guides
    * [Oracle Database](https://cloud.google.com/oracle/database/docs/overview)

## Example Usage - Oracledatabase Database Connection Basic


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {
  project_id = "my-project"
}

resource "google_oracle_database_autonomous_database" "target" {
  autonomous_database_id = "my-adb"
  location               = "us-east4"
  project                = "my-project"
  database               = "mydatabase"
  admin_password         = "123Abpassword"
  odb_network            = "projects/my-project/locations/us-east4/odbNetworks/my-odbnetwork"
  odb_subnet             = "projects/my-project/locations/us-east4/odbNetworks/my-odbnetwork/odbSubnets/my-odbsubnet"
  properties {
    compute_count            = "2"
    data_storage_size_tb     = "1"
    db_version               = "19c"
    db_workload              = "OLTP"
    license_type             = "LICENSE_INCLUDED"
    mtls_connection_required = "false"
  }
  deletion_protection = "true"
}

resource "google_secret_manager_secret" "password" {
  project   = "my-project"
  secret_id = "my-password-secret"
  replication {
    user_managed {
      replicas {
        location = "us-east4"
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "password" {
  secret      = google_secret_manager_secret.password.id
  secret_data = "123Abpassword"
}

resource "google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member" "password_accessor" {
  project   = google_secret_manager_secret.password.project
  secret_id = google_secret_manager_secret.password.secret_id
  role      = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
  member    = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-oci.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

resource "google_oracle_database_database_connection" "default" {
  database_connection_id  = "my-connection"
  location                = "us-east4"
  project                 = "my-project"
  connection_string       = "(description=(address=(protocol=tcps)(port=1521)(host=${google_oracle_database_autonomous_database.target.properties[0].private_endpoint_ip}))(connect_data=(service_name=${split("/", google_oracle_database_autonomous_database.target.properties[0].connection_strings[0].high)[1]}))(security=(ssl_server_dn_match=yes)(ssl_server_cert_dn=\"CN=${google_oracle_database_autonomous_database.target.properties[0].private_endpoint}\")))"
  username                = "ADMIN"
  password_secret_version = "projects/my-project/secrets/${google_secret_manager_secret.password.secret_id}/versions/${google_secret_manager_secret_version.password.version}"
  odb_network             = "projects/my-project/locations/us-east4/odbNetworks/my-odbnetwork"

  depends_on = [google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member.password_accessor]
}
```

## Example Usage - Oracledatabase Database Connection Full


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {
  project_id = "my-project"
}

resource "google_oracle_database_autonomous_database" "target" {
  autonomous_database_id = "my-adb"
  location               = "us-east4"
  project                = "my-project"
  database               = "mydatabase"
  admin_password         = "123Abpassword"
  odb_network            = "projects/my-project/locations/us-east4/odbNetworks/my-odbnetwork"
  odb_subnet             = "projects/my-project/locations/us-east4/odbNetworks/my-odbnetwork/odbSubnets/my-odbsubnet"
  properties {
    compute_count            = "2"
    data_storage_size_tb     = "1"
    db_version               = "19c"
    db_workload              = "OLTP"
    license_type             = "LICENSE_INCLUDED"
    mtls_connection_required = "false"
  }
  deletion_protection = "true"
}

resource "google_secret_manager_secret" "password" {
  project   = "my-project"
  secret_id = "my-password-secret"
  replication {
    user_managed {
      replicas {
        location = "us-east4"
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "password_v1" {
  secret      = google_secret_manager_secret.password.id
  secret_data = "123Abpassword"
}

resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "password_v2" {
  secret      = google_secret_manager_secret.password.id
  secret_data = "123Abpassword"

  depends_on = [google_secret_manager_secret_version.password_v1]
}

resource "google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member" "password_accessor" {
  project   = google_secret_manager_secret.password.project
  secret_id = google_secret_manager_secret.password.secret_id
  role      = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
  member    = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-oci.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

resource "google_oracle_database_database_connection" "default" {
  database_connection_id  = "my-connection"
  location                = "us-east4"
  project                 = "my-project"
  connection_string       = "(description=(address=(protocol=tcps)(port=1521)(host=${google_oracle_database_autonomous_database.target.properties[0].private_endpoint_ip}))(connect_data=(service_name=${split("/", google_oracle_database_autonomous_database.target.properties[0].connection_strings[0].high)[1]}))(security=(ssl_server_dn_match=yes)(ssl_server_cert_dn=\"CN=${google_oracle_database_autonomous_database.target.properties[0].private_endpoint}\")))"
  display_name            = "My Connection"
  username                = "ADMIN"
  password_secret_version = "projects/my-project/secrets/${google_secret_manager_secret.password.secret_id}/versions/${google_secret_manager_secret_version.password_v1.version}"
  odb_network             = "projects/my-project/locations/us-east4/odbNetworks/my-odbnetwork"
  labels = {
    env = "initial"
  }

  depends_on = [google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member.password_accessor]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `connection_string` -
  (Required)
  Oracle Easy Connect or TNS connection string.
  Example: "your-db-host.example.com:1521/YOUR_SERVICE_NAME"

* `location` -
  (Required)
  Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

* `database_connection_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the DatabaseConnection to create. This value is restricted
  to (^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$) and must be a maximum of 63
  characters in length. The value must start with a letter and end with
  a letter or a number.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  User-friendly display name for the connection.

* `labels` -
  (Optional)
  Optional: Labels as key-value pairs to organize the resource.
  **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
  Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.

* `odb_network` -
  (Optional)
  For Oracle Database@Google cloud resources.
  Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/odbNetworks/{odbNetwork}

* `password_secret_version` -
  (Optional)
  The resource name of the GCP Secret Manager secret version
  containing the password for the specified username.
  Format: projects/{project}/secrets/{secret_id}/versions/{version_id}
  The service's Per-Product Per-Project Service Account (P4SA)
  must have the 'secretmanager.secretAccessor' permission on this secret.

* `username` -
  (Optional)
  The default database username to use for connections.

* `wallet_secret_version` -
  (Optional)
  Optional: The resource name of the GCP Secret Manager secret version
  containing base64 encoded content of the Oracle Wallet ZIP file required
  for mTLS/TLS connections. Format:
  projects/{project}/secrets/{secret_id}/versions/{version_id} The
  service's Per-Product Per-Project Service Account (P4SA) must have the
  'secretmanager.secretAccessor' permission on this secret.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/databaseConnections/{{database_connection_id}}`

* `create_time` -
  The create time of the resource.

* `lifecycle_details` -
  Additional information about the current state of the connection.

* `name` -
  Identifier. The resource name of the DatabaseConnection.
  Format:
  projects/{project}/locations/{location}/databaseConnections/{database_connection}

* `state` -
  The current state of the connection.
  Possible values:
  CREATING
  ACTIVE
  FAILED
  DELETING

* `update_time` -
  The update time of the resource.

* `terraform_labels` -
  The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
   and default labels configured on the provider.

* `effective_labels` -
  All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


DatabaseConnection can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/databaseConnections/{{database_connection_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{database_connection_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{database_connection_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import DatabaseConnection using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    databaseConnectionId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_oracle_database_database_connection.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import DatabaseConnection using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/databaseConnections/{{database_connection_id}}"
  to = google_oracle_database_database_connection.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), DatabaseConnection can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_oracle_database_database_connection.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/databaseConnections/{{database_connection_id}}
$ terraform import google_oracle_database_database_connection.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{database_connection_id}}
$ terraform import google_oracle_database_database_connection.default {{location}}/{{database_connection_id}}
```
